test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the fifth number is related to the sixth number.

17 : 119 :: ? : 182 :: 23 : 161
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: First number × 7 = Second number**

 
• 17 : 119 → 17 × 7 = 119
 
• 23 : 161 → 23 × 7 = 161

Similarly,

 
• ? : 182 → ? × 7 = 182

 
 
• ? = 182 ÷ 7
 
• ? = 26
 
 

Hence, '**26**' is the correct answer.
